title: Codex-Claude Bridge user configuration
description: Optional user configuration read from CODEX_CLAUDE_CONFIG, else $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/codex-claude/config.json, else ~/.config/codex-claude/config.json. Every key is optional; an absent key keeps the built-in behaviour. Older versions do not read this file.

profile.description: Profile used when a delegation names none. sandbox-autonomous is unavailable and cannot be a default.

overagePolicy.description: What a job does when the worker starts drawing on overage billing. stop is the only value: the bridge never enables or continues into overage.

reviewLanePolicy.description: Permission profile for the legacy review lanes. null keeps the 1.x behaviour.

presets.description: Per-preset profile overrides, keyed by an existing agent preset name.

routing.description: Routing rules keyed by task family. A rule may name the worker family, the model and the effort; an omitted or null field leaves that choice to the host configuration.

extensions.description: Absolute paths of extension modules, loaded in order. A module that fails to load fails the delegation before launch.
